items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: It had a Black chorus line in there, a girl named Hortense Allen, who became quite a dancer... and she had a chorus line.

ctx.x: just had a beautiful time in St. Louis, and we worked there... The other club was a large club, too, a good club. It had a Black chorus line in there, a girl named Hortense Allen, who became quite a dancer, who was quite a dancer, and she had a chorus line. It was a very, very good show. And we just had a real ball for the next four weeks there. We rehearsed and got our repertoire together, and this allowed things to develop, because when a band can sit in one place for a while you can get things together, you…

There were a few little side incidents that happened in St. Louis. One day we were rehearsing, and these two White fellows came in to rehearsals, and they called Billy Eckstine over and was talking to him. Finally, Billy beckoned for Charlie Parker to come over. Charlie Parker went over, and this guy... Everybody was wondering what's happening. So this guy flashes a badge. It turned out he's an FBI man. And what had happened, they had been summoned to find Charlie Parker because he hadn't answered his draft call.…
